build_verification.command: tools/build-all.sh and tools/build-all.sh ground-truth-holdout, in the build image

cdxgen.notes: Held at 12.8.2 in every run, pinned by digest. Records source files in properties[].SrcFile without line numbers.

cdxgen-13.8.0.notes: --spec-version=1.6; otherwise the arguments of cdxgen 12.8.2. Each project gets its own output directory (harness/cdxgen-own-dir.sh).

cryptoscan.package_version: cryptoscan 1.5.0 (release tarball cryptoscan_1.5.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz, sha256 a9e05cf3a78cdb3a2a5cb7fb55fcc2e8d53a6d35519e1b15444432065716a0cc, checksum verified)
cryptoscan.notes: Defaults. Withholds findings it classes as quantum-safe (AES, SHA-2).

cryptoscan-quantum-safe.package_version: cryptoscan 1.5.0 (release tarball cryptoscan_1.5.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz, sha256 a9e05cf3a78cdb3a2a5cb7fb55fcc2e8d53a6d35519e1b15444432065716a0cc, checksum verified)

cbomkit-theia.package_version: cbomkit-theia v1.1.2 (dcd95ac), built from source of github.com/cbomkit/cbomkit-theia inside the pinned build image
cbomkit-theia.notes: Default plugins. Reads certificates, keys, java.security and OpenSSL configuration; no source code.

opengrep.package_version: opengrep 2.0.0 (opengrep_linux_x86, sha256 37e93f4da5fd04a18c5c1febbdd12f7e98dfccd4d0c9cf2593bcb25eeb462da0, cosign signature verified) with the 100 cryptography rules (harness/select_rules.py, by CWE) of opengrep-rules at f1d2b562, the archived head, rule content of 0f5a85ce (2024-12-13); rule set sha256/16 f98b5696b0867c1f by harness/ruleset-digest.sh
opengrep.notes: Each result is a component named by its rule id, at the reported file and line. Rule-set digest recipe: sha256 over sha256sum's lines ("<sha256>  <path>") for every selected rule file, paths relative to the rule directory and sorted bytewise, first 16 hex digits (harness/ruleset-digest.sh).

codeql.package_version: CodeQL bundle 2.27.5 (codeql-bundle-linux64.tar.gz, sha256 a5f205466b976ea9b345957fc133eeea9021e71aeffc99243ec7b9e99b1d6ed5, checksum verified), inventory queries only
codeql.notes: Inventory queries for C/C++, Python and Java, every one of those languages present in a project, build-mode none, inside the pinned build image; a project with none of them gets no document.
